body:
The ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) exam is a crucial step for those wishing to validate their software testing skills. Here’s a practical guide to help you prepare for the exam.

Examination structure and duration

The exam consists of 40 multiple-choice questions. The standard examination time is 1 hour (60 minutes). However, for participants whose mother tongue is not the language in which they are taking the exam, the exam time is extended to 1 hour and 15 minutes (75 minutes). The aim of this provision is to create a level playing field for all applicants, regardless of their mother tongue.

Examination languages

The ISTQB Foundation exam is available in several languages to facilitate access to certification: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Russian and Turkish. This linguistic diversity enables candidates to choose the language that suits them best, ensuring better understanding and an accurate assessment of their skills.

Exam content from May 6, 2024

From Monday May 6, 2024, ISTQB® Certified Tester Foundation Level exams will be based on the CTFL 4.0 syllabus. Candidates are advised to familiarize themselves with the new syllabus so as to be well prepared on exam day.

Success Criteria

To pass the exam, a minimum of 26 questions must be answered correctly. Wrong answers do not affect right answers, which means there is no penalty for incorrect answers. So it’s a good idea to answer all the questions, even if you’re not sure of some of the answers.

Examination results

Exam results are sent to the participant’s e-mail address after completion of the online exam. Be sure to check your inbox and your spam folder so you don’t miss this important communication.

Mock exam

We offer a 15-question test exam to help you prepare effectively. A sample exam is available on our website. To test your skills before the official exam, start here .

In conclusion, preparation for the ISTQB Foundation exam is essential for success and certification. By understanding the practicalities of the exam, you can better organize your time and effort to maximize your chances of success. Don’t forget to familiarize yourself with the CTFL 4.0 syllabus and to take advantage of the extra time allowed if your mother tongue is not the one with which you are taking the exam.

The ISTQB Foundation exam can be taken online or in person at our accredited center. This flexibility allows candidates to choose the modality that suits them best, ensuring an experience tailored to their needs as they work towards certification.

Good luck to all candidates!
